message.content: Camp Nou’s official seated capacity after its most recent renovations is **about 99,354 spectators**—the largest football‑only stadium in Europe. Historically it held over 110,000 people when standing areas were used, but modern safety regulations now limit it to roughly ninety‑nine thousand seats.
